scripts.clean: find . -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.log' -o -name '*.txt' \) -not -name 'eslint.config.js' -delete && rm -rf .eslintcache tsconfig.eslint.tsbuildinfo reports tmp node_debug.log eslint-suppressions.json test/dist && pnpm -r run clean:types && pnpm run clean:src-js && pnpm store prune
scripts.doctor:pnpm-install: bash -lc 'echo "== tool versions =="; node -v; pnpm -v; npm -v; echo; echo "== registry config =="; pnpm config get registry; npm config get registry; echo; echo "== proxy config (before) =="; pnpm config get proxy; pnpm config get https-proxy; npm config get proxy; npm config get https-proxy; echo; echo "== proxy environment =="; env | grep -iE "^(http|https|all)_proxy=" || echo "(none)"; stale_proxy="http://proxy:8080"; if [ "$(pnpm config get proxy)" = "$stale_proxy" ] || [ "$(pnpm config get https-proxy)" = "$stale_proxy" ] || [ "$(npm config get proxy)" = "$stale_proxy" ] || [ "$(npm config get https-proxy)" = "$stale_proxy" ]; then echo; echo "Detected stale proxy config ($stale_proxy). Clearing npm/pnpm proxy settings..."; pnpm config delete proxy || true; pnpm config delete https-proxy || true; npm config delete proxy || true; npm config delete https-proxy || true; else echo; echo "No stale proxy config detected; no proxy changes applied."; fi; echo; echo "== proxy config (after) =="; pnpm config get proxy; pnpm config get https-proxy; npm config get proxy; npm config get https-proxy; echo; echo "== npm registry ping =="; npm ping --registry https://registry.npmjs.org || true; echo; echo "== pnpm registry metadata fetch =="; pnpm view pnpm version --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --silent || true'
scripts.lint:ci: eslint . --max-warnings=0 --report-unused-disable-directives && pnpm run lint:workflows && pnpm run lint:yaml
scripts.report: bash -lc 'status=0; pnpm run build:ts || status=$?; pnpm run lint:report || status=$?; pnpm run lint:duplicates:report || status=$?; pnpm run test:ci || status=$?; pnpm run stats:report || status=$?; pnpm run tree:report || status=$?; pnpm run cli generate-quality-report || status=$?; exit $status'
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint:ci && pnpm test
scripts.test:ensure-junit:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='reports/tests.xml'; const status=process.env.TEST_STATUS ?? 'unknown'; const xml=fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').trim():''; const ok=xml.startsWith('<?xml')&&xml.includes('<testsuites')&&xml.includes('</testsuites>'); if(!ok){const m='Test runner exited with status '+status+' before producing a valid JUnit report.'; const e=m.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/'/g,'''); const fallback='<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
' + '<testsuites>
' + '  <testsuite name="test-runner" tests="1" failures="1" errors="0" skipped="0">
' + '    <testcase name="test-runner"><failure message="' + e + '">' + e + '</failure></testcase>
' + '  </testsuite>
' + '</testsuites>
'; fs.writeFileSync(p,fallback,'utf8'); }"
scripts.test: pnpm run build:ts && bash -lc 'mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:files); ((${#tests[@]})) || { echo "No compiled test files found under dist/ or test/" >&2; exit 1; }; node --test --test-timeout=120000 "${tests[@]}"'
scripts.test:quiet: pnpm run build:ts && bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:files); ((${#tests[@]})) || { echo "No compiled test files found under dist/ or test/" >&2; exit 1; }; node --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=tap "${tests[@]}" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^# (tests|suites|pass|fail|cancelled|skipped|todo|duration_ms)"'
scripts.test:report: bash -lc 'mkdir -p reports; rm -f reports/tests.xml; mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:files); if ((${#tests[@]})); then node --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=reports/tests.xml "${tests[@]}"; status=$?; else echo "No compiled test files found under dist/ or test/" >&2; status=1; fi; TEST_STATUS=$status pnpm -s test:ensure-junit; exit $status'
scripts.test:coverage: bash -lc 'rm -f reports/lcov.info && mkdir -p reports && ./node_modules/.bin/c8 --reporter=lcovonly --report-dir=reports node --test "**/*.test.js"; status=$?; rm -rf .nyc_output reports/tmp reports/lcov-report; exit $status'
scripts.test:ci: bash -lc 'mkdir -p reports; rm -f reports/lcov.info reports/tests.xml; mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:files); if ((${#tests[@]})); then ./node_modules/.bin/c8 --reporter=lcovonly --report-dir=reports node --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=reports/tests.xml "${tests[@]}"; status=$?; else echo "No compiled test files found under dist/ or test/" >&2; status=1; fi; TEST_STATUS=$status pnpm -s test:ensure-junit; rm -rf .nyc_output reports/tmp reports/lcov-report; exit $status'
scripts.test:format: pnpm run build:ts && bash -lc 'mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:format:files); ((${#tests[@]})) || { echo "No compiled format test files found" >&2; exit 1; }; node --test "${tests[@]}"'
scripts.test:format:report: bash -lc 'mkdir -p reports; rm -f reports/format.xml; pnpm run build:ts; mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:format:files); ((${#tests[@]})) || { echo "No compiled format test files found" >&2; exit 1; }; node --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/format.xml "${tests[@]}"'
scripts.test:fixtures: pnpm run build:ts && bash -lc 'mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:fixtures:files); ((${#tests[@]})) || { echo "No compiled fixture test files found" >&2; exit 1; }; node --test --test-timeout=120000 "${tests[@]}"'
scripts.test:performance: pnpm run build:ts && bash -lc 'mapfile -t tests < <(find src test -type f \( -path '\''*/dist/test/*performance*.test.js'\'' -o -path '\''*/dist/test/*perf*.test.js'\'' -o -path '\''*/dist/test/performance/*.test.js'\'' \) -not -path '\''*/node_modules/*'\''); tests+=(test/dist/fixture-profile-report.js); GMLOOP_FIXTURE_PROFILE=1 node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=reports/performance.xml --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=120000 "${tests[@]}"'
scripts.test:fixtures:profile:deep-cpu: pnpm run build:ts:incremental && GMLOOP_FIXTURE_PROFILE=1 GMLOOP_FIXTURE_DEEP_CPU=1 node --test test/dist/fixture-profile-report.js
scripts.commit: bash -lc 'msg=${BUMP_COMMIT_MESSAGE:-${npm_config_commit_message:-"chore: formatting"}}; if [ $# -gt 0 ]; then msg="$*"; fi; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then if [ -z "${SKIP_FORMAT:-}" ]; then pnpm run format:quiet; fi && (pnpm run lint:fix || true) && git add . && git commit --no-verify -m "$msg"; fi && git pull --rebase && git push' --
